Price gouged 118% on epitoc ear cleaning solution. Charged me $48 for a $22 over the counter flush you can get at petco. Called and asked i could return the unopened unused bottle not even 24 hrs from the appointment. The tech pretended to write my number down and said the office manager would call in 20 minutes. 2 days and no call. I suggest for anyone considering this place look up the medication they are trying to prescribe, especially over the counter bc more than likely it’s 80-100% cheaper literally anywhere else. I’ve taken 3 dogs to them at-least twice each and will not be returning. I feel totally scammed especially after paying $352

I recently brought my Persian kitten to Vetco because she had suddenly and mysteriously gotten sick. She wasn’t eating, was lethargic and not herself at all. I arrived for my appointment early and was seen right away. The vet tech and veterinarian were awesome. They took their time explaining everything to me and offered different plans of treatment. Blood work, FIV testing, an IV to take home, dewormer and parasite treatment, antibiotics, a round of Revolution, medicated eye drops, and probably more I’m forgetting was around $440 which was amazing. Since I was a first time customer, her physical was free. Clementine (my kitten) has made a complete 180 in just a few days! I will definitely be back should we ever need services again (but hopefully not 😅)

The worst vetco or animal hospital I have ever been to.  Never had a vet not examine the animal in front of me.  They prescribed a bunch of procedures before they even looked at my cat and did not care to explain why some of the procedures were necessary or not. They charged an extra $200 for an x-ray to be sent off to some internet company or something on top of the x-ray fee.  Never had that happen in any other hospital unless it is a new procedure. I asked why it was necessary, why can’t they just look at it here and I didn’t need it.  They didn’t care to explain properly. They just told me that’s just how it is also try to add blood work for some reason but had that taken off. They told me the result would take an hour but it came back in 5 minutes.  The result was pretty much inconclusive so it didn’t really give me peace of mind either.  Basically, they did all that for nothing and told me to come back if needed.  Luckily, I didn’t have to. Overall, I don’t care about paying for good, necessary services but zero transparency and bad communication made this the worst vet trip. I felt like they didn’t seem to care about the pet’s overall well-being.
